headline: Approved temporary zoning moratoriums on battery energy storage systems and large-scale data centers.
summary: Planning Board Chair Paula Caron asked for both pauses, and the Zoning Board and Community Development and Planning supported them. Speakers agreed both technologies are fairly new and their effects are not known. Attorney Christine Tree said Fitchburg Fiber is a pre-existing, nonconforming use that should be allowed to continue.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the September 15, 2026 meeting, 5-0.
Approved a temporary zoning moratorium on Locally Regulated Commercial Battery Energy Storage Systems (LRC-BESS), 5-0 by unanimous consent.
Approved a temporary zoning moratorium on large-scale data centers, 5-0 by unanimous consent.

decision_titles: Temporary zoning moratorium on large-scale data centers
plain_text:
CITY OF FITCHBURG 
 
NOTICE OF PUBLIC MEETING 
 
 
AGENDA 
 
 
 
LEGISLATIVE AFFAIRS COMMITTEE MEETING - MINUTES 
 
 
MEETING DATE: Tuesday, October 06, 2026 
 
MEETING TIME: 6:00 PM 
 
MEETING PLACE: LEGISLATIVE BUILDING 
 
MEETING ADDRESS: 700 Main Street, Fitchburg, MA 
Chair Walsh, Cruz, Starr, Van Hazinga & 
COMMITTEE MEMBERS: Zarrella 
 
All committee members were present. The Committee was joined by Paula Caron, Planning Board Chair; Liz 
Murphy, Community Development and Planning Director; and Attorney Christine Tree, Zoning Board Chair. 
The meeting began at approximately 6:05pm. 
 
Approval of the following Minutes: September 15, 2026. The Minutes were approved, 5-0. 
 
159-26. Paula Caron, Chair, Fitchburg Planning Board: Request to amend Chapter 181 of the 
Fitchburg Zoning Code to establish a temporary zoning moratorium on Locally Regulated 
Commercial Battery Energy Storage Systems (LRC-BESS). 
 
 Discussion centered on the  fact that the technology is fairly new. The moratorium on 
LRC-BESS is supported by the Planning Board, Zoning Board, and Community 
Development and Planning. General agreement by the committee that the effects of this 
technology are not known. 
   
  Approved by Unanimous Consent, 5-0. 
 
   
160-26.           Paula Caron, Chair, Fitchburg Planning Board, request to amend chapter 181 of the 
Fitchburg zoning code to add a temporary zoning moratorium on large-scale data centers. 
 
Discussion centered on the fact that this is also a fairly new technology. The moratorium on 
data centers is supported by the Planning Board, Zoning Board, and Community 
Development and Planning. Attorney Tree expressed her concern that Fitchburg Fiber is a 
pre-existing, nonconforming use, but that it should be allowed to continue; she also stated 
that although Governor Healey has issued an Executive Order to pause data center 
development, that order can change.  
 
Approved by Unanimous Consent, 5-0.  
 
The meeting was adjourned at 6:31pm. 
 
Beth Walsh, Chair, Legislative Affairs Committee
Posted By Joanna Bilotta-Simeone, Clerk 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
*Please note: Massachusetts Open Meeting Law requires that all topics that the Chair reasonably anticipates must be listed and 
that the list of topics must be sufficiently specific to reasonably inform the public of the issues to be discussed at the meeting.
